kammayanta.p: [Kamma+yanta] (na) CL=7 (A) The mechanism that is so-called the force (or) compulsion of action. (B) Mechanism (body or five aggregates embodying a being) that is related to Kamma (action). (B) See - Kammayantavighāṭana.
